abstract: CATEomics addresses the lack of a standardized and reproducible process for choosing among conditional average treatment effect (CATE) estimators in high-dimensional omics studies, where their estimation errors cannot be evaluated directly from observed outcomes. The R package accepts a SummarizedExperiment, applies common preprocessing and data partitions across R and Python estimators, compares their out-of-fold estimates using proxy losses, supports model selection and ensembling, and returns the resulting CATE estimates to the original object for downstream omics analysis. Availability and implementation: CATEomics is implemented in R and is freely available under the MIT license at https://github.com/matsui-lab/CATEomics. The software version described here (v0.99.0) is archived on Zenodo at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24189754. A vignette illustrates the complete workflow from a SummarizedExperiment to downstream analysis.
